detail.zh-CN: 渲染中途停下后，用 multiplane resume 从停下的地方接着渲，不用从头再来。
detail.en: After a render stops part way, multiplane resume continues from where it stopped instead of starting over.

detail.zh-CN: 浏览器卡住时自动重启并重做这一帧，画面不变，并给出提示。
detail.en: A stuck browser is restarted and the frame rendered again, with the same pixels and a warning.

detail.zh-CN: 停止时有浏览器卡住，5 秒后直接关掉它；已编好的段保留，可以续传。
detail.en: A browser stuck while stopping is closed after 5 seconds; finished segments are kept for resuming.

detail.zh-CN: 运动帧不再重复做静止检查，快 2～9%，画面不变。
detail.en: Motion frames skip a redundant still check: 2–9% faster with identical output.
